phase_title: Workflow Router Screen Correction and Guided Current Action UI
title: Repair Validation Routing Gate
repair_trigger: WC04-REPAIR01 Architect review found that live current-action routing advances to WC05 even though WC04 is deferred and WC04-REPAIR01 has not received Operator repair validation.
included_scope: Treat deferred/not-validated Operator decisions as unresolved even when raw validation result says Pass.
Make Operator decision override raw validation result when they conflict.
Route repair Work Card plus repair Implementer Report but no repair validation to repair validation required.
Prevent WC05 routing until WC04 or its active repair route has a passing Operator validation decision.
Add targeted current-action routing fixture coverage.
out_of_scope: Do not create Operator validation records.
Do not broaden renderer filesystem access.
acceptance_criteria: Raw Pass plus Deferred Operator decision is not treated as passing.
Deferred, failed, blocked, partial, rejected, and repair-required outcomes keep the Work Card unresolved.
Router does not advance WC04 to WC05 while WC04-REPAIR01 lacks passing repair validation.
Current durable repo state routes to WC04-REPAIR01 repair validation or equivalent repair-validation-required state, not WC05.
Targeted fixture coverage exists for deferred/raw-pass conflict and unresolved repair validation routing.
Validation/build commands pass or skipped checks are documented.
next_action_after_completion: Architect review of WC04-REPAIR02 Implementer Report
